Planning Commission
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 17, 2013
6:00 P.M.
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES: August 20, 2013
AGENDA CHANGES *3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - MATTERS NOT ON THE AGENDA
PUBLIC HEARING ITEMS
1.
PC8-245 - Family Dollar (Continued) A request for a Special Use Permit to allow a bargain basement store at 943
E.
Vista Way. This project has been determined to be exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with CEQA Guidelines Section 15301. A Notice of Exemption will be filed with the County of San Diego.
2.
PC2-104 -- Anna Lane Subdivision A request for a Tentative Subdivision map to create five single-family lots, private street and drainage improvements at the southern end of Anna Lane, addressed as 1874 Anna Lane. This project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with Section 15332 of the CEQA Guidelines. A Notice of Exemption will be filed with the County of San Diego.
3.
DISCUSSION ITEM PC19-061, General Plan 2030
City staff will review existing General Plan policies and request direction on possible policy changes or new policies for the Vista General Plan 2030.
ADJOURNMENT
